record.issue_text: The database is updated before the external calendar update; if `updateCalendarAttendees` fails, new attendees remain persisted and Cal.com becomes inconsistent with the calendar provider.

adjudication.rationale: Looking at addGuests.handler.ts, the code first updates the database with `prisma.booking.update` (around line 85-100) to add new attendees, then later calls `eventManager.updateCalendarAttendees(evt, booking)` (around line 155). If the calendar update fails, the database already has the new attendees persisted, but the external calendar provider won't have them. This creates an inconsistency between Cal.com's database and the external calendar. The code doesn't wrap these operations in a transaction or have rollback logic.
